profile.summary: McCampbell Analytical is a full-service environmental and analytical testing laboratory in the San Francisco Bay Area. It tests water, soil, air and hazardous materials for contaminants such as metals and PFAS (a class of long-lasting chemicals). Its customers include environmental consultants, municipalities, industrial clients and homeowners.
